title: Boeing FY2022 10-K — MD&A on reach-forward losses, BDS development-program charges, and long-term contract accounting
key_points: Boeing recorded a $6,493M reach-forward loss on the 777X program in FY2020 and a $3,460M reach-forward loss on the 787 program in FY2021; both flow through cost of sales.

FY2022 BDS had a loss from operations of $3,544M versus earnings of $1,544M in FY2021, 'primarily due to charges on development programs' — this is what drove the $3,837M increase in consolidated cost of sales in FY2022.
BCA loss from operations decreased $4,105M in FY2022 vs FY2021 'primarily due to the absence in 2022 of the $3,460 million reach-forward loss taken on the 787 program in 2021'.

Boeing states that 'Substantially all contracts at our BDS segment and certain contracts at our BGS segment are long-term contracts with the U.S. government and other customers that generally extend over several years', implying revenue/cost recognition over long contract lives rather than unit-level COGS matching.

BGS results are materially moved by cumulative catch-up adjustments: 'The net unfavorable impact of cumulative contract catch-up adjustments in 2022 was $148 million worse than the net favorable impact in the prior year.'

title: Boeing FY2022 10-K — Note 1, Revenue and Related Cost Recognition (p63)
key_points: Note 1 的 'Revenue and Related Cost Recognition' 按合同类型（商用飞机合同 / 长期合同）划分，而非按'产品成本 / 服务成本'给出定义。
商用飞机合同：收入在飞机完工并被客户接受时点确认；成本侧 'We use program accounting to determine the amount reported as cost of sales'。
长期合同（BDS 几乎全部合同、BGS 部分合同）的产品类销售包括战斗机、旋翼机、网络安全产品、监视套件、先进武器、导弹防御、军用衍生飞机、卫星系统、客机改货机。
长期合同的服务类销售包括与商用及防务产品相关的支持与维护协议，以及 Commercial Crew 的太空飞行。
公司有四个报告分部：Commercial Airplanes (BCA)、Defense, Space & Security (BDS)、Global Services (BGS)、Boeing Capital (BCC)。
raw_excerpt: Revenue is recognized for each commercial aircraft performance obligation at the point in time when the aircraft is completed and accepted by the customer. We use program accounting to determine the amount reported as cost of sales. … Products sales under long-term contracts primarily include fighter jets, rotorcraft, cybersecurity products, surveillance suites, advanced weapons, missile defense, military derivative aircraft, satellite systems and modification of commercial passenger aircraft to cargo freighters. Sales of services under long-term contracts primarily include support and maintenance agreements associated with our commercial and defense products and space travel on Commercial Crew.

title: Boeing FY2022 10-K — Note 1, long-term contract loss provisions and cumulative catch-up (p64)
key_points: 长期合同采用累计追赶（cumulative catch-up）法，在当期确认对当期及前期影响的累计数。
当长期合同的总收入与总成本估计显示亏损时，'a provision for the entire reach-forward loss on the long-term contract is recognized'（全额、立即确认）。
2022 年全部长期合同的净累计追赶调整使收入减少 $2,335M、使 Loss from operations 增加 $5,253M。
2021 年对应为收入减少 $379M、Loss from operations 增加 $880M；2020 年为收入减少 $359M、Loss from operations 增加 $942M。
长期合同可以是固定价格，也可以是成本加成（reimbursed for costs incurred plus an agreed upon profit）。
raw_excerpt: When the current estimates of total revenues and costs at completion for a long-term contract indicate a loss, a provision for the entire reach-forward loss on the long-term contract is recognized. … Decrease to Revenue ($2,335) ($379) ($359) / Increase to Loss from operations ($5,253) ($880) ($942)

title: Boeing FY2022 10-K — Note 7, 787 reach-forward loss recorded as reduction to deferred production costs (p81)
key_points: 2021Q4 判定 787 项目预计完工成本加已计入 787 存货的成本超过预计收入，产生的 reach-forward loss $3,460M 'was recorded as a reduction to deferred production costs'（冲减递延生产成本，而非单列费用行）。
2022-12-31 与 2021-12-31，787 项目存货包含 deferred production costs $12,689M / $11,693M、supplier advances $1,831M / $1,907M、unamortized tooling and other non-recurring costs $1,722M / $1,815M。
2022-12-31，$9,881M 的 787 递延生产成本及工具/非重复性成本预期由已获确定订单的会计数量单位收回，$4,530M 预期由未来订单单位收回。
777X 项目在 2022-12-31 为 near break-even margins。
raw_excerpt: During the fourth quarter of 2021, we determined that estimated costs to complete the 787 program plus costs already included in 787 inventory exceed estimated revenues from the program. The resulting reach-forward loss of $3,460 was recorded as a reduction to deferred production costs. … deferred production costs of $12,689 and $11,693, $1,831 and $1,907 of supplier advances, and $1,722 and $1,815 of unamortized tooling and other non-recurring costs.

title: Boeing FY2022 10-K — Note 7, abnormal production costs expensed as incurred (p81)
key_points: 因 2022 年 4 月决定在 2022–2023 年暂停 777X-9 生产，产生异常生产成本，'being expensed as incurred until 777X-9 production resumes'；2022 年计入 $325M。
787 项目：2021Q3 判定低于 5 架/月的生产速率为 abnormally low production rates，且库存飞机的检查与返工成本属 excessive，两者均被判定为 abnormal production costs，'required to be expensed as incurred'。
截至 2022-12-31 累计异常成本 $1.7B；2022Q4 将异常生产成本总额估计上调至 $2.8B，大部分将在 2023 年底前发生（2021-12-31 时预期累计约 $2B）。
上调主因是 2022Q4 因供应链约束决定放缓近期生产，以及检查与返工成本上升。
raw_excerpt: The production pause is resulting in abnormal production costs that are being expensed as incurred until 777X-9 production resumes. We expensed abnormal production costs of $325 during the year ended December 31, 2022. … We also determined that the inspections and rework costs on inventoried aircraft are excessive and should also be accounted for as abnormal production costs that are required to be expensed as incurred. Cumulative abnormal costs recorded through December 31, 2022 totaled $1.7 billion. … We expensed abnormal production costs of $1,240 and $468 during the years ended December 31, 2022 and 2021.

title: Boeing FY2022 10-K — MD&A 787 Program, abnormal costs and 'consolidated costs of products and services' (p34–p35)
key_points: MD&A 披露 2022 年 '$0.3 billion of abnormal costs were period expensed'（777X-9 停产相关）。
787 段落以 'consolidated costs of products and services' 表述收尾，表明异常生产成本最终落在合并口径的 cost of products and services 之中，而非被排除在毛利之外。
787 项目 2022 年交付 31 架；2022-12-31 与 2021-12-31 分别约有 100 架与 110 架飞机在存货中，2022 年底存货中大部分预计 2024 年底前交付。
公司预计 2023 年逐步恢复至每月 5 架的生产速率。
raw_excerpt: During the year ended December 31, 2022, $0.3 billion of abnormal costs were period expensed. … We are currently producing at low rates and expect to gradually return to 5 per month in 2023. … consolidated costs of products and services.

title: Boeing FY2022 10-K — Note 22, Unallocated Items, Eliminations and other (p117)
key_points: 'Unallocated items, eliminations and other' 包含支持 Boeing 全球业务的共同内部服务、向 BCC 提供的公司间担保、以及某些分部间销售的抵销。
分部间销售包括卖给 BCC 分部并由 BCC 出租给客户的飞机，这些飞机被视为转移至 BCC 分部。
公司一般按美国联邦成本会计准则（U.S. federal cost accounting standards）将成本分摊到业务分部。

构成明细（2022 / 2021 / 2020）：Share-based plans ($114)/($174)/($120)；Deferred compensation $117/($126)/($93)；Amortization of previously capitalized interest ($95)/($107)/($95)；Research and development expense, net ($278)/($184)/($240)；Eliminations and other unallocated items ($1,162)/($676)/($1,807)；合计 ($1,532)/($1,267)/($2,355)。

title: Boeing FY2022 10-K — MD&A, Loss from operations bridge and FAS/CAS service cost adjustment (p25)
key_points: Loss from operations 的桥接：Segment operating loss ($3,158) + Pension FAS/CAS service cost adjustment $849 + Postretirement FAS/CAS service cost adjustment $294 + Unallocated items, eliminations and other ($1,532) = Loss from operations ($3,547)。

2021 年 BCA 亏损减少 $7,372M 主因：2020 年 777X 的 $6,493M reach-forward loss 不再发生，部分被 2021 年 787 的 $3,460M reach-forward loss 抵消。

title: Boeing FY2022 10-K — Critical Accounting Policies, Program Accounting and program-level gross margin (p50–p51)
key_points: Program accounting 'requires the demonstrated ability to reliably estimate revenues, costs and gross profit margin for the defined program accounting quantity'。
10-K 使用 'gross margin' 一词时指项目层面（program-level）的估计毛利率，而非公司层面毛利指标。
'The 767, 777X, and 787 programs had near break-even or single digit margins at December 31, 2022'；777X 为 near break-even gross margins。
敏感性披露：若盈利性长期合同的合计毛利率估计上下变动 1%，2022 年税前利润将变动约 $300M。
2022 年净累计追赶调整使 Loss from operations 增加 $5,253M，主因 VC-25B、KC-46A Tanker、MQ-25、Commercial Crew、T-7A Red Hawk 等固定价格开发项目的亏损。
2022Q4 将 787 项目会计数量上调 100 架，'The increase in the accounting quantity improved the program's profit margin'。
raw_excerpt: Program accounting requires the demonstrated ability to reliably estimate revenues, costs and gross profit margin for the defined program accounting quantity. … The 767, 777X, and 787 programs had near break-even or single digit margins at December 31, 2022. Adverse changes to the revenue and/or cost estimates for these programs could result in earnings charges in future periods. … If the combined gross margins for our profitable long-term contracts had been estimated to be higher or lower by 1% during 2022, it would have increased or decreased pre-tax income for the year by approximately $300 million.

title: The Boeing Company FY2022 Form 10-K — Note 7 Inventories: 787 reach-forward loss, 787/777X abnormal production costs
key_points: The 787 reach-forward loss of $3,460 million was determined in Q4 2021 and recorded as a reduction to deferred production costs; no new 787 reach-forward loss is disclosed for FY2022.
787 abnormal production costs expensed were $1,240 million in FY2022 versus $468 million in FY2021.
777X abnormal production costs of $325 million were expensed in FY2022 following the April 2022 decision to pause 777X-9 production during 2022 and 2023.
The 777X program had near break-even margins at December 31, 2022.
787 deferred production costs were $12,689 million at 12/31/2022 vs $11,693 million at 12/31/2021.
737 deferred production costs were $2,955 million at 12/31/2022 vs $1,296 million at 12/31/2021; unamortized tooling and other non-recurring costs $626 million vs $617 million.
Commercial aircraft programs inventory included approximately 250 737 aircraft and 100 787 aircraft at 12/31/2022, versus 335 737 and 110 787 at 12/31/2021.

title: The Boeing Company FY2022 Form 10-K — Cash Flow 讨论（现金流驱动因素归因）
key_points: 2022 年存货改善由 737 MAX 交付增加与 787 交付恢复驱动。
2022 年 Advances and progress billings 提供现金 $0.1B，2021 年提供 $2.5B，2020 年使用现金 $1.1B。
2022 年非现金项目减少 $3.4B，主要因 2021 年记录的 787 reach-forward loss $3.5B。
2022 年与 2021 年分别收到所得税退税 $1.5B 与 $1.7B。
2022 年应付账款增长是现金来源，2021 年应付账款下降是现金使用项。
raw_excerpt: Inventory improvements were driven by higher 737 MAX deliveries and resumption of 787 deliveries in 2022. … Cash provided by Advances and progress billings was $0.1 billion in 2022, as compared with $2.5 billion of cash provided in 2021. The $3.4 billion reduction in non-cash items in 2022 is primarily driven by the $3.5 billion reach-forward loss on the 787 program that was recorded in 2021. / Concessions paid to 737 MAX customers totaled $1.0 billion and $2.5 billion during 2022 and 2021.

title: The Boeing Company FY2022 Form 10-K — Cost of sales（披露口径为 cost of sales % of revenues，非 gross margin）
key_points: Boeing 在 MD&A 中披露 cost of sales 及其占收入比：FY2022 $63,106M / 94.7%，FY2021 $59,269M / 95.2%，FY2020 $63,843M / 109.8%。
FY2022 cost of sales 同比增加 $3,837M，主因 BDS 记录的减值以及 BCA 收入上升。
10-K 明确「cost of sales 占收入比在 2022 年与 2021 年基本持平」。
10-K 未以 gross margin / gross profit 作为标题指标披露。
raw_excerpt: Cost of sales $63,106 $59,269 $3,837 $59,269 $63,843 ($4,574) / Cost of sales as a % of Revenues 94.7 % 95.2 % (0.5)% 95.2 % 109.8 % (14.6)% / Cost of sales as a percentage of Revenues remained largely consistent in 2022 compared to 2021.

title: The Boeing Company FY2022 Form 10-K — Risk Factors: 固定价格合同占比
key_points: BDS 与 BGS 国防业务 2022 年分别约 60% 与 69% 的收入来自固定价格合同。
BDS 与 BGS 国防业务 2022 年分别约 40% 与 31% 的收入来自成本型合同安排。
Boeing 在风险因素中明确：固定价格合同若发生成本超支，可能使其承担损失。
raw_excerpt: Our BDS and BGS defense businesses generated approximately 60% and 69% of their 2022 revenues from fixed-price contracts. While fixed-[price contracts…] / Our BDS and BGS defense businesses generated approximately 40% and 31% of their 2022 revenues from cost-type contracting arrangements.

title: The Boeing Company FY2022 Form 10-K — BDS Results of Operations（分部由盈转亏与项目减值明细）
key_points: 下降主因是累计合同 catch-up 调整比 2021 年不利 $4,284M。
2022 年固定价格研制项目减值：VC-25B $1,452M、KC-46A Tanker $1,374M、MQ-25 $579M、T-7A Red Hawk Production Options $552M、T-7A Red Hawk EMD $203M、Commercial Crew $288M。
2021 年确认的减值包括 KC-46A Tanker $402M、VC-25B $318M、Commercial Crew $214M。
BDS FY2022 收入 $23,162M，较 FY2021 减少 $3,378M，主因研制项目减值。
raw_excerpt: BDS loss from operations in 2022 of $3,544 million decreased by $5,088 million compared with earnings from operations of $1,544 million in 2021 primarily due to unfavorable impacts of cumulative contract catch-up adjustments ($4,284 million more unfavorable in 2022 than 2021). / Charges of fixed price development programs in 2022 included VC-25B ($1,452 million), KC-46A Tanker ($1,374 million), MQ-25 ($579 million), T-7A Red Hawk Production Options ($552 million), T-7A Red Hawk Engineering, Manufacturing and Development (EMD) ($203 million), and Commercial Crew ($288 million).

title: The Boeing Company FY2022 Form 10-K — Critical Audit Matters（program accounting 估计的计量不确定性）
key_points: 审计师指出 Boeing 使用 program accounting 计算每架售出商用飞机的 cost of sales 与 margin。
program accounting 要求估计并证明会计数量内的客户需求，并估计每个项目全生命周期的销售与成本。
审计师明确：估计初始会计数量及其中未售单位的销售与成本「涉及计量不确定性，导致一系列合理结果」。
审计师明确：会计数量或取证相关监管要求的收入与成本估计变更「可能导致更低利润率或重大 reach-forward loss」。
777X 与 787 的 program accounting 估计被分别列为关键审计事项。
raw_excerpt: The Company uses program accounting to compute cost of sales and margin for each commercial airplane sold. The use of program accounting requires estimating and demonstrating customer demand for the number of units included in the program (program accounting quantity) and estimating the sales and costs over the expected life of each program. … estimating the sales and costs associated with the initial program accounting quantity and the unsold units within the program accounting quantity involve measurement uncertainty resulting in a range of reasonable outcomes. … Changes to the revenue and cost estimates related to the program accounting quantity or regulatory requirements to achieve certification could occur, resulting in lower margins or material reach-forward losses.

title: The Boeing Company FY2022 Form 10-K — 异常生产成本（abnormal production cost）的费用化处理
key_points: 2021 年第三季度 Boeing 判定低于 5 架/月的生产率为「异常低生产率」，会产生异常生产成本。
2022 年 4 月决定 2022–2023 年暂停 777X-9 生产；暂停期间的异常生产成本在发生时即费用化，直至 777X-9 恢复生产。
2022 年费用化异常生产成本 $325M（777X）。
2022 年末 787 约有 100 架飞机在存货中（2021 年末约 110 架），其中大部分预期在 2024 年底前交付。
Boeing 当时以低速率生产 787，并预期 2023 年逐步恢复至每月 5 架。
raw_excerpt: In the third quarter of 2021, we determined that production rates below 5 per month represented abnormally low production rates and result in abnormal production costs. / In April 2022, we decided to pause production of the 777X-9 during 2022 and 2023. The production pause is resulting in abnormal production costs that are being expensed as incurred until 777X-9 production resumes. We expensed abnormal production costs of $325 during the year ended December 31, 2022. / At December 31, 2022, and 2021, we had approximately 100 and 110 aircraft in inventory.
